audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1, 2 and 3 were all scored Gangplank at 8/10 while the matching whys say the opposite — whys[0] ends 'so concede and last-hit safe', whys[1] warns not to follow a Parrrley into his auto range, whys[2] says 'the lane levels out'. First item was scored Skill while whys[5] says 'You out-scale outright'.
audit.why: 49.81% over 803 games: Warwick owns the first levels, it evens out at your second Q/E point, and you take over from your Sheen item. The packet chart (Warwick, Warwick, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank) matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the packet chart, ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] and phases[5] were generic boilerplate that named neither champion's spike.
audit.why: The actual level-6 change is Primal Howl plus Infinite Duress, and the first-item change is Sheen out-pacing his drain. Neither was stated in the full layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl (E) does not appear anywhere in this matchup — not in the full layer, not in a spike, not in a want. Riot's text: 'Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.' Separately, 'Cleanse it with Q' appears in dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t — Gangplank's cleanse is W.
audit.why: Primal Howl is the ability that both blunts your keg burst and fears you off your own barrels, and it was invisible. Also unstated: his R leap 'scaling with his bonus Move Speed', so a Blood Hunt-active Warwick reaches much further than the base leap suggests.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl's 1s flee and 2.5s damage reduction added to phases[4].why and dontsFull[2].d; Blood Hunt's effect on R range added; Remove Scurvy named as the cleanse in dosFull[0].d.
sources: enemyKit E, R and W text

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] is titled 'Anti-heal his Q sustain' but its detail was a trading line, and dontsFull[1] 'Fight without anti-heal' had an unrelated cooldown line.
audit.why: Three separate parts of his kit heal (passive, Q, R) and Eternal Hunger triples its healing below 25% health — that is the real reason Grievous Wounds is not optional here, and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal reasoning with the 25% threshold written into dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: All three content paragraphs (early, mid, late) are in FIRST PERSON — 'his Q heals off my max health', 'This evens out as my second Q/E point lands', 'My Sheen into the keg build is where I take over'.
audit.why: The rest of the site coaches in second person. This reads as a different author.
audit.corrected: All three converted to second person at the same length.

edits.before: Warwick owns the first three levels and there's no pretending otherwise — his Eternal Hunger passive heals hardest exactly when he's drained you under half HP, his Q heals off my max health on top, and my kegs come up on long cooldowns at low durability he can just free-hit to deny before they're useful. Don't throw a Parrrley and then step into auto range to follow it up; he'll Blood Hunt onto me with the move speed and out-sustain the trade every time. Last-hit with the tip of Q, place kegs back from the wave so he can't free-detonate or deny them, and accept I'm conceding this phase. The one thing to bait: an early Q leap onto a keg — if he commits it for nothing, he's out of position with it on cooldown.

edits.before: This evens out as my second Q/E point lands and I can start chaining Parrrley-into-keg poke from outside his walk-up range — he has to eat chip to farm now, and his drain can't heal what it can't reach. At 6 his R suppresses me in place for the lock his passive feeds on, but Remove Scurvy (W) cleanses the suppression mid-channel and heals me off missing HP, so the entire all-in hinges on me holding W for the ult, not burning it on his Blood Hunt chase. Bait the R, cleanse it, and the fight flips. Outside of a jungler collapsing on the suppress, this stage is a genuine coin-flip on who respects the other's cooldown.
edits.after: This evens out as your second Q/E point lands and you can chain Parrrley-into-keg poke from outside his walk-up range — he has to eat chip to farm now, and his drain can't heal what it can't reach. At 6 his R suppresses you in place for the lock his passive feeds on, but Remove Scurvy (W) cleanses the suppression mid-channel and heals off your missing HP, so the whole all-in hinges on holding W for the ult, not burning it on his Blood Hunt chase. Watch for Primal Howl too: 2.5s of damage reduction, then a 1s fear that walks you off your own barrels. Bait the R, cleanse it, and the fight flips.

edits.before: My Sheen into the keg build is where I take over — an empowered Parrrley detonating a chained barrel finally bursts faster than his drain heals, and from there I'm the scaling carry. By two items chained keg explosions and global Cannon Barrage zoning beat a Warwick whose sustain stops being relevant once a single combo bursts him; his HP stacking just gives my barrels a bigger target and anti-heal caps his drain. The only late danger is getting caught sidelaning alone — his R is still a point-and-click lock that holds long enough for his team if my W is down, so keep Remove Scurvy for his ult and fight near my barrels, never out in the open.
edits.after: Your Sheen into the keg build is where you take over — an empowered Parrrley detonating a chained barrel finally bursts faster than his drain heals, and from there you are the scaling carry. By two items chained keg explosions and global Cannon Barrage zoning beat a Warwick whose sustain stops mattering once a single combo bursts him; his HP stacking just gives your barrels a bigger target and anti-heal caps his drain. The only late danger is getting caught sidelaning alone — his R is a 70s lock at rank 3 that holds long enough for his team if your W is down, so keep Remove Scurvy for his ult and fight near your barrels, never out in the open.

notes: The claim that Remove Scurvy cleanses Infinite Duress's suppression appears in spikes[1], whys[3], mid and wants.you[0], and the whole matchup is built on it. Riot's text for Remove Scurvy says only 'cure crowd control effects' and says nothing about suppression eligibility, and the kit file's needsResearch is empty by design, so I could not verify it and left every one of those sentences intact rather than guess in either direction. Flagged in unverified — it is the single highest-leverage fact on this page. Packet suspect name 'His Infinite Duress' is a false positive.
